name: You
description: A dangerously charming, obsessive man goes to extreme measures to insert himself into the lives of women who fascinate him.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: A charming first encounter quickly turns into something more nefarious when bookstore manager Joe takes a very strong liking to grad student Beck.

videos.title: The Last Nice Guy in New York
videos.overview: As Beck deals with unwanted advances from her advisor, she brings Joe to Peach's high society soiree. Joe tries to navigate matters with Benji.

videos.title: Maybe
videos.overview: Beck's continued casual encounters catch Joe off guard, as does a run-in with the police. Both make him realize a key situation must be dealt with.

videos.title: The Captain
videos.overview: After an awkward evening with Beck, Joe discovers he's not the only one keeping secrets. Peach's antagonistic approach to Joe intensifies.

videos.title: Living with the Enemy
videos.overview: A video from Annika's past comes back to haunt her. Joe and Peach's simmering tension boils over when Peach introduces Beck to a major literary agent.

videos.title: Amour Fou
videos.overview: Beck heads to Connecticut with Peach, whose motives are not what they seem. Joe's pursuit of her stirs up old memories – and brings new injuries.

videos.title: Everythingship
videos.overview: A grieving Beck turns to therapy, which leads Joe to do the same – for different reasons. Joe's plans for Beck's birthday don't go as expected.

videos.title: You Got Me, Babe
videos.overview: Three months later, life is good for Joe and Beck, respectively. But a series of reconnections may spell trouble for Joe's current relationship.

videos.title: Candace
videos.overview: So, what exactly happened to Candace? Beck is determined to find out – but to do so, she'll have to take a page straight from Joe's book.

videos.title: Bluebeard's Castle
videos.overview: Joe juggles problems with Paco and Beck – and now must contend with a private investigator as well. But resolution is coming, one way or another.

videos.title: A Fresh Start
videos.overview: Joe – now "Will" – arrives in his own personal hell on Earth: LA. He's trying to go straight, but the past doesn't always leave well enough alone.

videos.title: Just the Tip
videos.overview: Joe realizes Will Bettelheim isn't all he's cracked up to be. The fallout threatens to get in the way of his burgeoning connection with Love.

videos.title: What Are Friends For?
videos.overview: Joe attempts to keep things platonic with Love and keep his nose out of Ellie's business. But his instincts soon get the better of him.

videos.title: The Good, the Bad, & the Hendy
videos.overview: As he tries to adapt to sharing Love with Forty, Joe is caught off guard by a group date – while his protectiveness of Ellie quickly escalates.

videos.title: Have a Good Wellkend, Joe!
videos.overview: Love brings Joe to a wellness weekend, where he gets a good look at her family's dynamic. But Forty's surprise guest has him feeling anything but zen.

videos.title: Farewell, My Bunny
videos.overview: Joe performs surveillance on a potential problem, but suspects someone might be tailing him, too. Painful memories put Love on edge about the present.

videos.title: Ex-istential Crisis
videos.overview: To soothe heartache, Joe turns to ancient remedies, modern technology and drinking with Delilah. But one small slip-up could have major consequences.

videos.title: Fear and Loathing in Beverly Hills
videos.overview: Joe wants to get away, but Forty insists they finish their script. As pressure mounts, Forty's excessive coping devices make for a harrowing night.

videos.title: P.I. Joe
videos.overview: As Love looks after an increasingly skittish Ellie, Joe tries to reconstruct the events of a trippy evening – but finds the truth to be elusive.

videos.title: Love, Actually
videos.overview: Joe has always been full of surprises, but Love has a few of her own. Is this the beginning of the end, or the end of the deceiving?

videos.title: And They Lived Happily Ever After
videos.overview: After a delivery room surprise, new dad Joe struggles to connect with his infant child, but he has no trouble at all fostering a new infatuation.

videos.title: So I Married an Axe Murderer
videos.overview: Joe and Love try couples therapy, but their issues may need more than counseling – and their friction isn't the only thing they need to make disappear.

videos.title: Missing White Woman Syndrome
videos.overview: Love grows apprehensive as media scrutiny intensifies next door. An acute sickness in the family drudges up old memories – and worse – for Joe.

videos.title: Hands Across Madre Linda
videos.overview: An impulsive retaliation by Love lands her and Joe in a bind. Though Joe seeks a different way out than usual, it proves to be a tall order.

videos.title: Into the Woods
videos.overview: Joe begrudgingly goes on a hunting trip with some other local husbands as Love tries to manage her burgeoning relationship with Theo.

videos.title: W.O.M.B.
videos.overview: As her mother launches a new venture, Love grows increasingly concerned about a potential big change herself. Joe has a breakthrough in self-awareness.

videos.title: We're All Mad Here
videos.overview: While Dottie spirals into emotional turmoil, Love tries to get intel on Matthew's investigation. Joe sets his sights on derailing Marienne's ex.

videos.title: Swing and a Miss
videos.overview: Joe selfishly tries to coerce Love into a lifestyle change, but things go south quickly. Theo discovers just how deep Matthew's obsession goes.

videos.title: Red Flag
videos.overview: While Love tends to some unexpected long-term guests, Joe decides to take a drastic step to get what he wants the most.

videos.title: What Is Love?
videos.overview: As news permeates the community about a recent murder, Joe looks toward a future with Marienne – but hell hath no fury like Love scorned.

videos.title: Joe Takes a Holiday
videos.overview: Now living in London, Joe tries to lay low and resist old habits... until he's forced to tie up loose ends and bond with a circle of wealthy socialites.

videos.title: Portrait of the Artist
videos.overview: Joe leans on his skills — and a student's insights — to catch his stalker. An art show offers a gallery of suspects, revealing more than the eye can see.

videos.title: Eat the Rich
videos.overview: As news of a killer targeting the rich swirls, Joe's stalker inches dangerously close to the truth. Joe's efforts to protect Kate take a dark turn.

videos.title: Hampsie
videos.overview: A ritzy weekend getaway doubles as a chance for Joe to hunt down his elusive stalker. Without cell service or Wi-Fi, Joe makes a key connection.

videos.title: The Fox and the Hound
videos.overview: While falling back into familiar patterns, Joe gets caught up in an unfortunate game as everyone's plans go up in flames.

videos.title: Best of Friends
videos.overview: In the aftermath of the murders, Joe searches for a scapegoat and Rhys pursues his grand ambitions while Kate and Phoebe assert their independence.

videos.title: Good Man, Cruel World
videos.overview: The tables turn for Joe when an influential figure comes to town with a tempting offer as Nadia follows a hunch.

videos.title: Where Are You Going, Where Have You Been?
videos.overview: As memories of the past trickle in, Joe struggles to recall an important detail. Phoebe shares her hasty plans with Kate. Nadia scrambles for a solution.

videos.title: She's Not There
videos.overview: Torn between his dark side and good intentions, Joe works to right his wrongs. After attempting to help Phoebe, Kate faces her father – and hard truths.

videos.title: The Death of Jonathan Moore
videos.overview: With love and loss weighing heavily on his mind, Joe commits a final act in hopes of never walking down the same path again.

videos.title: The Luckiest Guy in NY
videos.overview: Joe and Kate settle in New York with a pledge to start over, but their headline-making marriage hits a snag when betrayal strikes close to home.

videos.title: Blood Will Have Blood
videos.overview: A family dinner descends into chaos when Kate's sister Reagan makes a shocking allegation. Bronte's curiosity lands her in a tight spot.

videos.title: Imposter Syndrome
videos.overview: Joe hits an impasse in Mooney's basement, as tension builds at home. Kate plays hardball to protect Henry. Bronte faces exposure at a literary salon.

videos.title: My Fair Maddie
videos.overview: A game-changing announcement at Lockwood Corporation sets off alarm bells for Kate. An unwelcome guest crashes Mooney's grand reopening.

videos.title: Last Dance
videos.overview: Fueled by fear, Kate finds answers from a troubled source. A puzzling note at work sends Joe on a search for the whereabouts of a missing person.

videos.title: The Dark Face of Love
videos.overview: A viral video complicates Joe's dreams of a fresh start — and forces Bronte to question her loyalties. Kate makes changes at home.

videos.title: #JoeGoldberg
videos.overview: As faces from his past resurface, the "most visible man in New York" must sway the court of public opinion.

videos.title: Folie a Deux
videos.overview: With their relationship at a crossroads, Joe gives Bronte a gift to test her commitment. Kate finds a shoulder to lean on.

videos.title: Trial of the Furies
videos.overview: Joe must use all his talents to liberate himself from the Lockwoods' financial grip. Kate tries a dose of deception to achieve her goal.

videos.title: Finale
videos.overview: Hoping to decisively close the book on the past, Joe embarks on a risky new chapter. But as with every great story, one last twist awaits.
